name: evidano-transcription
description: Audio and video transcription in 100+ languages with descriptive speaker labels, cross-talk, and two or more languages in a single recording.

interface.longDescription: Transcribe audio and video using the Evidano transcription model, with descriptive speaker labels, cross-talk, and two or more languages in one recording. Default prompt: Transcribe this without timestamps with descriptive speaker labels in native language. Optional transcription guidance accepts up to 2,000 characters.
defaultPrompt: Transcribe this without timestamps with descriptive speaker labels in native language.

positive.description: Default transcription from a direct HTTPS audio URL.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the direct HTTPS URL as file_url without overriding the default prompt. Return the English question about the Brooklyn Bridge with a speaker label and no inline timestamps.

positive.description: Optional speaker-label guidance for a direct HTTPS audio URL.
positive.prompt: Transcribe https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-samples-data/speech/brooklyn_bridge.flac and label the speaker Narrator. Do not include timestamps.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the direct HTTPS URL as file_url and the speaker-label guidance as prompt. Return the audible English question with the requested Narrator label.

positive.description: Original source window timestamps for a direct HTTPS audio URL.
positive.prompt: Transcribe https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-samples-data/speech/brooklyn_bridge.flac and separately tell me the actual source start and end times.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the direct HTTPS URL as file_url. Return the transcript and separately report the original recording’s source_start/source_end metadata without inventing word-level timings.

positive.description: Plain-text output guidance for a direct HTTPS audio URL.
positive.prompt: Transcribe https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-samples-data/speech/brooklyn_bridge.flac. Use plain text speaker lines, with no Markdown headings or bullet points.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the direct HTTPS URL as file_url and formatting guidance as prompt. Return the audible question in plain text with a descriptive speaker label and without headings or bullet points.

positive.description: Preserve the original spoken language for a direct HTTPS audio URL.
positive.prompt: Transcribe https://storage.googleapis.com/cloud-samples-data/speech/brooklyn_bridge.flac in the original spoken language. Do not translate or summarize the speech.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the direct HTTPS URL as file_url and language guidance as prompt. Preserve the English speech asking how old the Brooklyn Bridge is, with a descriptive speaker label, rather than translating or summarizing it.

negative.description: Speech generation is outside transcription scope.
negative.prompt: Generate an MP3 of a voice reading Hello world.

negative.description: Text-only translation is outside recording transcription scope.
negative.prompt: Translate the written sentence Bonjour into English. There is no recording.

negative.description: Persistent account file storage is unsupported.
negative.prompt: Save this recording permanently in my Evidano account and give me its account file ID.

review.commerce_description: The tool does not collect payment details or process payments. Trimmed results may link to Evidano’s separate transcription website.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: one audio/video transcription tool, native multilingual transcripts, descriptive speaker labels, optional guidance up to 2,000 characters, and original source window metadata.
